The position will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records and documentation, processing bills and vouchers, monitoring project expenditures against the approved budget, preparing financial reports, supporting procurement and administrative functions, and ensuring compliance with the organization’s financial policies and applicable donor requirements. The position is essential for ensuring transparency, accountability, timely financial reporting, proper documentation, and smooth day-to-day financial and administrative operations of the project. Monitor project expenditures against the approved budget and prepare necessary financial statements and analyses. Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports as required. Maintain and regularly update the cash book, ledger, bank book, and other relevant accounting records. Carry out banking activities, cheque/payment processing, and other necessary financial transactions. Support and facilitate project procurement and administrative activities in accordance with organizational policies and procedures. Maintain records of office assets, stationery, supplies, and other project materials. Maintain staff attendance, leave records, and other relevant administrative documents. Prepare and maintain necessary supporting documents and records for internal and external audits. Ensure compliance with the project’s financial procedures, SPUS Financial Policy, approved budget, and relevant donor compliance requirements. Perform any other financial and administrative duties assigned by the appropriate authority in relation to the project.
